Privacy Policy

Last updated: 11 August 2026 — Template only. Have this reviewed by a lawyer before publishing, and update it to match your actual data practices, tools and jurisdiction.

1. Who we are

VisionCraft Labs ("we", "us") operates visioncraft-labs.com and provides website, app, AI creative and brand design services. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.

2. Information we collect

  • Information you submit through our contact and project forms (name, company, email, phone, project details, budget and timeline).
  • Basic analytics data (pages viewed, referral source, device type, approximate location) collected via our analytics tool.
  • Information you send us directly by email.

3. How we use it

  • To respond to project inquiries and scope proposals.
  • To improve the performance and usability of this website.
  • To send project-related communication — never unsolicited marketing without consent.

4. Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate this site (e.g. hosting, form handling, analytics), under confidentiality obligations.

5. Cookies

This site may use essential cookies for functionality and, where enabled, analytics cookies to understand site usage. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

6. Your rights

You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us at visioncraftlabs@gmail.com.

7. Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to visioncraftlabs@gmail.com.
